note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. One contest, Derrylea; the other divisions were uncontested and are recorded from the Fermanagh Herald's full nomination list (4 June 1955, p. 8). Dresternan is not in the Herald's printed list and is not yet found (7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Fermanagh Herald, 4 June 1955, p. 8 (council-audit, Nov 2026): 'Colebrooke—Alfred Hurst' as printed (previously Hart); Alfred Hurst held Colebrooke in 1939 and 1949. Renamed from 'Colebrooke' to Colebrook (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Colebrook; the rounds were filed as Colebrook (1924, 1964); Colebrooke (1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961). This round was filed as 'Colebrooke', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (colebrooke) answers with a redirect to this one.
